shortDescription.default: Configurable tiles, cards, banners, and resource lists.

longDescription.default: Tile Studio v1.4.5: reusable enterprise cards, tiles, navigation, responsive layouts and read-only SharePoint list content. Native SharePoint property-pane editor, individually configured links, privacy-aware image host controls, design presets and configurable accessibility options. Modular editor architecture with separated content, layout, style, responsive and preset sections.
